TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings directly relevant, recently completed solar PV delivery experience together with proven execution in government and healthcare environments in Pakistan. We were established in 2012 and maintain offices in Islamabad (HQ), Lahore, and Karachi, enabling multi-site delivery and after-sales coverage aligned to the twelve-hospital footprint in Punjab [CO-PROFILE].

Closest matching renewable energy past performance includes three completed “Solar Energy deployment” contracts: PKR 171M delivered in 10 months (completed 2024) [CAP-032], PKR 31M delivered in 33 months for a Provincial Government client (completed 2024) [CAP-008], and PKR 34M delivered in 20 months for a Federal Government client (completed 2020) [CAP-020]. These projects evidence our ability to execute end-to-end deployment delivery within comparable budget bands and under public-sector governance, supporting the RFP’s mandatory requirement for at least two completed renewable/solar projects and prior experience with federal/provincial government clients [CAP-008][CAP-020].

In parallel, we have delivered multiple hospital/healthcare deployments for government clients, including a PKR 182M Hospital IT deployment for a Federal Government client (15 months, completed 2020) [CAP-042] and a PKR 66M Hospital IT deployment for a Provincial Government client (28 months, completed 2023) [CAP-018]. This experience is directly relevant to executing civil/electrical works, safety management, coordination, and staff-facing handover/training activities at operational healthcare facilities [CAP-042][CAP-018].

Compliance readiness is supported by our ISO 9001 certification (mandatory M2) [CO-PROFILE], FBR NTN with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status (mandatory M6) [CO-PROFILE], and bank guarantee facility enabling bid securities via scheduled banks (mandatory M4) [CO-PROFILE]. Our library does not yet evidence SCADA/IoT centralized dashboards, net-metering approvals with DISCOs, or three-year PV O&M with performance guarantees on prior solar contracts; we will address these elements through a dedicated specialist subcontractor/partner under TechnoCore’s ISO 9001-controlled delivery and with our in-country support desk SLAs and quarterly preventive maintenance model [CO-PROFILE].
